summary.text: Tennyson Moreno is the Republican candidate for the Texas House of Representatives, District 45, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Democratic incumbent Erin Zwiener.
He also ran against Zwiener in 2024, and he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his background is in aviation, logistics and Texas politics.

paragraphs.text: Tennyson Moreno was born in Texas and earned an associate degree from Tarrant County College in 2020.
His Ballotpedia profile lists his career experience as government administration.
In a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey completed in 2026, Moreno said he grew up in a single-mother household, earned a pilot's license in high school and lives in San Marcos.
He said he volunteers with the Commemorative Air Force and serves as vice-chair of the Airport Advisory Board for the San Marcos Regional Airport.
Moreno was the Republican nominee for the same District 45 seat in 2024, when Zwiener won with 56.8 percent of the vote to his 43.2 percent.
For 2026, he listed public safety, lowering taxes and abolishing the property tax, and infrastructure as his key messages.
